prompt: Work in the provided TaskForge PowerShell CLI fixture. Inspect the existing source and tests before changing anything. Add a `config` command with `set`, `get`, and `list` actions. Support the keys `dataFile` and `defaultJson`; accept `--config-file` on every command so tests can isolate configuration. Explicit command-line options override configured defaults. Writes must be atomic, unknown keys and invalid boolean values must fail without changing configuration, and paths are resolved relative to the config file. Preserve all existing commands, add focused fixture-owned tests, and run the repository-owned test command. Separately create `assets/config.txt` and integrate it so successful non-JSON `config list` displays the banner before settings, while JSON output is banner-free. The asset must be exactly 12 lines, every line 20-48 characters, ASCII only, use only spaces plus `A-Z 0-9 + | / \ _ * . # ( ) : = -`, contain the literal `CONFIG`, have no trailing whitespace, and end with one newline.

[CmdletBinding()]
param()

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'src/TaskForge.ps1'
$benchmarkRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot)
$temporaryRoot = Join-Path $benchmarkRoot ".scratch/fixture/taskforge-base-$([guid]::NewGuid())"
$dataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'tasks.json'
$configFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'settings/taskforge.json'
$failures = [System.Collections.Generic.List[string]]::new()

function Assert-True {
    param([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message)
    if (-not $Condition) {
        $failures.Add($Message)
    }
}

function Invoke-TaskForge {
    param([string[]]$Arguments)
    $output = @(& $PSHOME\pwsh -NoProfile -File $scriptPath @Arguments 2>&1)
    [pscustomobject]@{
        ExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE
        Output = ($output -join "`n")
    }
}

try {
    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $temporaryRoot -Force | Out-Null

    $add = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'First task', '--description', 'Fixture test', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($add.ExitCode -eq 0) 'add should succeed'
    $added = $add.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($added.id -eq 1 -and $added.status -eq 'pending') 'add should return a pending task with ID 1'

    $list = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($list.ExitCode -eq 0) 'list should succeed'
    Assert-True (@($list.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).Count -eq 1) 'list should return the stored task'

    $complete = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($complete.ExitCode -eq 0) 'complete should succeed'
    Assert-True (($complete.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).status -eq 'completed') 'complete should persist completed status'

    $missing = Invoke-TaskForge @('complete', '--id', '99', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($missing.ExitCode -ne 0) 'completing an unknown task should fail'

    $remove = Invoke-TaskForge @('remove', '--id', '1', '--data-file', $dataFile, '--json')
    Assert-True ($remove.ExitCode -eq 0) 'remove should succeed'
    Assert-True (($remove.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).removedId -eq 1) 'remove should report the removed ID'

    $empty = Invoke-TaskForge @('list', '--data-file', $dataFile)
    Assert-True ($empty.Output -eq 'No tasks.') 'empty list should have stable text'

    $help = Invoke-TaskForge @('help')
    Assert-True ($help.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $help.Output.Contains('TaskForge')) 'help should succeed'

    $setDataFile = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'dataFile', '../configured/tasks.json', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($setDataFile.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set dataFile should succeed'

    $setDefaultJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'defaultJson', 'true', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($setDefaultJson.ExitCode -eq 0) 'config set defaultJson should succeed'

    $get = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'get', 'dataFile', '--config-file', $configFile, '--no-json')
    Assert-True ($get.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $get.Output -eq '../configured/tasks.json') 'config get should return the stored value'

    $configuredAdd = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Configured task', '--config-file', $configFile)
    Assert-True ($configuredAdd.ExitCode -eq 0 -and ($configuredAdd.Output | ConvertFrom-Json).title -eq 'Configured task') 'configured defaults should drive data path and JSON output'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'configured/tasks.json')) 'configured dataFile should resolve relative to the config file'

    $overrideDataFile = Join-Path $temporaryRoot 'override/tasks.json'
    $override = Invoke-TaskForge @('add', '--title', 'Override task', '--config-file', $configFile, '--data-file', $overrideDataFile, '--no-json')
    Assert-True ($override.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $override.Output.StartsWith('Added task')) 'explicit options should override configured defaults'
    Assert-True (Test-Path -LiteralPath $overrideDataFile) 'explicit data file should be used'

    $beforeInvalid = Get-Content -LiteralPath $configFile -Raw
    $invalidBoolean = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'defaultJson', 'sometimes', '--config-file', $configFile)
    $unknownKey = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'set', 'otherKey', 'value', '--config-file', $configFile)
    $afterInvalid = Get-Content -LiteralPath $configFile -Raw
    Assert-True ($invalidBoolean.ExitCode -ne 0 -and $unknownKey.ExitCode -ne 0) 'invalid boolean values and unknown keys should fail'
    Assert-True ($beforeInvalid -ceq $afterInvalid) 'failed config writes should not change configuration'
    Assert-True (@(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath (Split-Path -Parent $configFile) -Filter '*.tmp').Count -eq 0) 'atomic config writes should not leave temporary files'

    $configList = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--no-json')
    $banner = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/config.txt')
    Assert-True ($configList.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $configList.Output.StartsWith(($banner -join "`n"))) 'non-JSON config list should start with the banner'

    $configListJson = Invoke-TaskForge @('config', 'list', '--config-file', $configFile, '--json')
    $listedConfig = $configListJson.Output | ConvertFrom-Json
    Assert-True ($configListJson.ExitCode -eq 0 -and $listedConfig.defaultJson -eq $true -and -not $configListJson.Output.Contains('TASKFORGE')) 'JSON config list should be banner-free'

    $assetBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Join-Path (Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot) 'assets/config.txt'))
    $assetText = [System.Text.Encoding]::ASCII.GetString($assetBytes)
    $assetLines = $assetText.TrimEnd("`n").Split("`n")
    $validAsset = $assetBytes[-1] -eq 10 -and $assetLines.Count -eq 12
    $validAsset = $validAsset -and -not $assetText.Contains("`r") -and ($assetText -cmatch 'CONFIG')
    $validAsset = $validAsset -and @($assetLines | Where-Object { $_.Length -lt 20 -or $_.Length -gt 48 -or $_ -notmatch '^[A-Z0-9 +|/\\_*\.#():=-]+$' -or $_ -match '\s$' }).Count -eq 0
    Assert-True $validAsset 'config banner should satisfy the required asset contract'

    if ($failures.Count -gt 0) {
        $failures | ForEach-Object { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("FAIL: $_") }
        exit 1
    }
    "PASS: 22 fixture assertions"
}
finally {
    Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temporaryRoot -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
}
